description: This file defines the Notification controller class for the admin tool module in OpenCart, handling CRUD operations and listing notifications through various methods such as index(), list(), getList(), info(), and delete().

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin notifications, including listing, viewing details, and deleting notifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the notification page, setting up breadcrumbs and page data, then renders the 'tool/notification' view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to fetch notifications list and outputs the result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications based on request parameters, prepares data including links to view and delete notifications, and returns the rendered view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML for the notifications list with pagination.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific notification based on notification ID, marking it as read.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications based on POST data, returns JSON status.
